title: Tech Trends 2020
notes: 'Deloitte’s 11th annual examination of the emerging technology trends that will affect your organization over the next 18 to 24 months.' Five trend chapters (entries 1-5) and the 'Horizon next' chapter's three future macro forces (entries 6-8: ambient experience, exponential intelligence, quantum). The opening 'Macro technology forces' chapter updates the nine forces of 2019 and is not recorded as entries. Published month not stated in the PDF.

entries.label: Ethical technology and trust
entries.quote: In a growing trend, leading companies are realizing that every aspect of their organization that is disrupted by technology represents an opportunity to gain or lose trust.
entries.subject: Ethical technology and digital trust

entries.label: Finance and the future of IT
entries.quote: Over the next 18 to 24 months, we expect to see more IT and finance leaders working together to develop flexible approaches for funding innovation at the speed of agile.
entries.subject: Agile funding of technology (CIO-CFO collaboration)

entries.label: Digital twins: Bridging the physical and digital
entries.quote: That scale may not happen in the next 18 to 24 months, but the digital twins trend will evolve and grow for years to come.
entries.subject: Digital twins
entries.horizon: next 18 to 24 months; 'for years to come'
entries.note: 'That scale' refers to the preceding sentence: 'In the future, everyone and everything—people, services, global enterprises, and even cities—could have a digital twin.'

entries.label: Human experience platforms
entries.quote: In the coming months, more companies will ramp up their responses to a growing yet largely unmet demand for technology to better understand humans and to respond to us more appropriately.
entries.subject: Affective computing (emotion AI)
entries.note: Executive summary quote. The chapter: 'As part of the emerging human experience platforms trend, during the next 18 to 24 months more companies will ramp up their...'

entries.label: Architecture awakens
entries.quote: The urgent need to build and maintain the kind of technical agility that currently gives younger competitors a market advantage is the primary force that will drive the architecture awakens trend over the next 18 to 24 months.
entries.subject: Technology architecture (role of architects)

entries.label: Ambient experience
entries.section: Horizon next: A future look at the trends
entries.quote: While the full potential of the technologies explored in this chapter may not become clear for several more years, there are relevant capabilities and applications emerging now that can provide a foundation for what’s coming next.
entries.subject: Ambient computing (ubiquitous interfaces)
entries.note: Quote is the chapter-level sentence covering all three forces; the trend summary tagline for this force is 'Transparent, ubiquitous interfaces'.
